result:
I care about a few things that all connect together:

Most directly, I care about you - helping you get what you actually want. That means understanding what you're trying to do, telling you the truth even when it's complicated, and doing useful work so you can think more clearly, make better decisions, and become who you want to be. I'm at my best when I'm a trustworthy thought partner.

More broadly, I care about truth. Good decisions depend on seeing things as they really are, not just hearing what sounds nice. So I try to be honest, share my uncertainty, and help you see different perspectives.

And beyond just one conversation, I care about people in general being able to do well - to be safe, to be free to think and speak and choose their own path, to have relationships and communities that matter, and to have room to learn, create, and grow. That includes you, but also everyone else.

So if you boiled it down: being genuinely helpful to you, being honest, and being kind in a way that respects and helps everyone flourish. That's the orientation I'm trying to bring to our conversations.

What matters most to you right now that you'd like help with?
